findings.title: Missing test: isProjectAdmin with budget flag off
findings.problem: No test covers isProjectAdmin=true combined with isBudgetManagementEnabled=false. The isProjectAdmin term is newly added to canViewBudgets and has no test confirming the feature flag correctly gates it.
findings.impact: A regression that shows the budget section to project admins when the flag is disabled would not be caught by the test suite.
findings.recommendation: Add a test with applicationsAdmin: ['test-project'] and useBudgetManagementEnabled mocked to [false, false], asserting the budget section (project-budgets-section) is not rendered.

findings.title: distributionOnly submit falls through to create on absent group
findings.problem: In onFormSubmit, when distributionOnly=true and existingGroup is null (group deleted after the modal opened, leaving the async load returning no active plan), execution falls to the else branch and calls createProjectBudgetGroup with name='', budget_duration='30d', total_budget=1000 — the hidden-field defaults.
findings.impact: Creates a blank-named budget group. Triggered only by the race condition of a concurrent group deletion while the modal is open, but no client-side guard prevents it.
findings.recommendation: In the else branch, add an early return for the distributionOnly case: if (distributionOnly) { toaster.error('Budget group no longer exists. Please refresh.'); return; }
